operations.name: Yubico Authenticator
operations.description: Install the pinned Yubico Authenticator GUI in an owned user directory and launcher; RIDE does not configure a connected key.

operations.name: YubiKey Manager CLI
operations.description: Install Fedora’s signed YubiKey Manager CLI without configuring or changing any connected YubiKey.

operations.name: Network scanner for Internet-wide studies
operations.description: Install Fedora zmap; RIDE manages RPM presence and never runs probes or emits network traffic.

operations.name: DNF5 automatic updates
operations.description: Install Fedora's signed DNF5 automatic-update plugin and systemd timer units; this does not enable a timer.

operations.name: Enable auditd
operations.description: Enable or disable auditd at boot without replacing audit rules.

operations.name: Owned user Bash aliases
operations.description: Load the user Bash aliases file and manage a bounded set of RIDE-owned aliases without overwriting unowned shell configuration.

operations.name: Firefox preferences and migration prompt
operations.description: Apply the kept v2 Firefox defaults through Firefox AutoConfig using an opt-in, ownership-checked Fedora system configuration.

operations.name: Firefox managed add-ons
operations.description: Manage the kept Firefox add-on list as verified XPI files in Firefox's global Linux extension directory; removal has a pending-restart state and preserves unrelated policy and profile data.

operations.name: Chrome recommended user defaults
operations.description: Apply selected user-changeable Google Chrome defaults through the host recommended-policy path imported by the Flathub wrapper; disabling Safe Browsing is an explicit opt-in selection.

operations.name: Flathub system remote
operations.description: Enable the verified system Flathub remote without installing applications or runtime data.

operations.name: GNOME calendar week numbers
operations.description: Show or hide week numbers in the GNOME calendar.

operations.name: GNOME top-bar date
operations.description: Show or hide the date in the GNOME top bar.

operations.name: GNOME custom keyboard shortcuts
operations.description: Add configurable RIDE-owned custom shortcuts and merge the selected show-desktop and switch-windows bindings without replacing unrelated user keybindings.

operations.name: GNOME favorite applications
operations.description: Set an explicit, configurable list of GNOME favorite application desktop IDs and restore the exact prior user list.

operations.name: GNOME location service
operations.description: Enable or disable the current user GNOME location setting.

operations.name: GNOME idle and lock timing
operations.description: Select a retained GNOME idle and lock timing pair or explicit enabled/disabled state while preserving exact prior user settings.

operations.name: GNOME middle-button paste
operations.description: Enable or disable primary-selection paste with the middle mouse button.

operations.name: GNOME problem reporting
operations.description: Enable or disable the current user GNOME technical-problem reporting setting.

operations.name: GNOME user region
operations.description: Set the current user's region to an explicit locale or empty string selected in a profile; the empty value preserves the legacy reset behavior with exact prior-state recovery.

operations.name: GNOME window button layout
operations.description: Set one explicit window-button layout for the current user.

operations.name: iBus emoji hotkey for Terminator
operations.description: Move the current user's iBus emoji hotkey to Control-Alt-Shift-E and journal the exact prior user override.

operations.name: RPM Fusion repositories
operations.description: Enable Fedora 44 RPM Fusion free and nonfree repositories from signature-verified release packages.

operations.name: UPower low-battery warning threshold
operations.description: Set a selected low-battery percentage in an owned UPower drop-in.

operations.name: MulticastDNS through authselect
operations.description: Enable or disable the Fedora authselect with-mdns4 feature with exact profile-selection recovery.

operations.name: User default directories
operations.description: Create ~/bin and ~/git only when absent, and remove only empty directories created by RIDE.

operations.name: WireGuard key pair
operations.description: Generate and own a local WireGuard key pair without configuring or activating an interface.

operations.name: NetworkManager VPN profiles
operations.description: Remove explicitly selected inactive VPN profile UUIDs and restore their exact NetworkManager keyfiles.

operations.name: Fedora Multimedia package updates
operations.description: Update only installed Fedora 44 Multimedia group packages from the fixed reviewed package list.

operations.name: DNF5 automatic package updates
operations.description: Enable or disable the DNF5 automatic install timer through a RIDE-owned systemd service override with exact prior timer recovery.

operations.name: DNF5 mirror and parallel download tuning
operations.description: Use a RIDE-owned DNF5 configuration drop-in to enable fastest-mirror selection and 15 parallel downloads, preserving unrelated administrator configuration.

operations.name: Static system hostname
operations.description: Set a validated static system hostname from a private profile value and journal the prior static name for exact restore.

operations.name: Update all Fedora packages
operations.description: Explicitly update all installed Fedora 44 Workstation or Server packages through DNF5 after a preview that rejects removals and downgrades; record transaction and reboot assessment. This action is non-restorable and never reboots automatically.

operations.name: Glances system monitor
operations.description: Install the Fedora Glances terminal monitor; this operation does not enable its web service or expose a network port.

operations.name: Docker Engine CE
operations.description: Install Docker Engine CE from the verified Docker Fedora repository and start its service; removal preserves Docker image, container, and volume data.

operations.name: Glances Web monitor service
operations.description: Enable the Fedora packaged Glances Web UI on loopback for local access or SSH port forwarding; do not open a firewall port.

operations.name: Disable direct SSH root login
operations.description: Set PermitRootLogin no through a RIDE-owned sshd drop-in, validate effective root policy, and reload sshd without changing existing sessions.
operations.license: BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND ISC AND SSH-OpenSSH AND ssh-keyscan AND snprintf AND LicenseRef-Fedora-Public-Domain AND X11-distribute-modifications-variant

operations.name: Allow a named user to reboot through SSH
operations.description: Grant one explicitly selected non-root local user passwordless sudo for exactly /usr/bin/systemctl reboot. Does not grant broader systemctl access or execute a reboot.

operations.name: Selected keyfile encrypted mount
operations.description: Remove or restore one explicitly selected keyfile-backed crypttab mapping and matching fstab row. Never changes a keyfile, LUKS header, or encrypted data; refuses active or mounted targets.

operations.name: Tailscale client
operations.description: Install the Tailscale Linux client from its stable Fedora repository. RIDE manages package and repository presence only; tailnet login, node identity, routes, exit-node behavior, and firewall policy remain outside this operation.

operations.name: AMP instance manager
operations.description: Install CubeCoders AMP's pinned instance-manager RPM from its official HTTPS artifact URL. RIDE suppresses RPM scriptlets to avoid automatic AMP timers, firewall updates, service activation, and recursive ownership changes; applying the package does not provision a controller, credentials, license data, runtimes, or instances.

operations.name: Plex Media Server
operations.description: Install Plex Media Server from its current signed RPM repository. This operation preserves server library data on package removal and does not configure firewall access or authenticate a server account.

operations.name: Plex Media Server service
operations.description: Enable and start or stop and disable the RPM-owned Plex Media Server unit, preserving library files and leaving firewall and account settings unchanged.

operations.name: GTK+ 2 runtime
operations.description: Install the Fedora gtk2 runtime package for opt-in NetworkMiner use.
operations.license: Multiple SPDX licenses; see Fedora package metadata

operations.name: Mono runtime
operations.description: Install the Fedora mono-core runtime package for opt-in NetworkMiner use.
operations.license: Multiple SPDX licenses; see Fedora package metadata

operations.name: Mono Windows Forms runtime
operations.description: Install the Fedora mono-winforms runtime package for opt-in NetworkMiner use.
operations.license: Multiple SPDX licenses; see Fedora package metadata

operations.name: NetworkMiner network forensic analyzer
operations.description: Install the pinned NetworkMiner 3.2 Linux archive in user-local program paths. Captures and assembled-file output stay in private user data outside RIDE removal.
